full_prompt_en: A square storybook landscape painting looks down a winding stone path toward pale cottages and a vivid blue lake among rounded hills. The path enters from the lower center, curves left past dense shrubs, and reaches a small cluster of cream stone houses with steep slate roofs. Their dark door and windows are simply marked, and tall tapering trees stand beside them. Beyond the houses, the lake spreads across the middle in a saturated blue, narrowing into an inlet between distant hills. A second pale building sits farther back across the water, partly surrounded by dark green rounded trees. The foreground is packed with small dome-like bushes in olive, lime, teal, blue-green, and warm brown. Fence posts trace a short line along the right side of the path. On both banks, fields are divided into curved yellow-green strips that follow the rolling contours of the hills. Fine parallel strokes and concentric bands emphasize their rounded volume. Clusters of trees alternate between small bulbous crowns and tall pointed forms, with hints of orange and rust among the greens. The far valley climbs into layered hills under a clear blue sky and a line of large cream-white clouds. No people dominate the view; a few tiny pale specks on the right hillside remain too small to identify with certainty. The surface is densely worked, with stippled vegetation, directional field marks, and tiny dark outlines that keep each shape distinct. Bright daylight from the upper left warms the fields and buildings, while the lake and shadowed trees preserve cooler blue-green depth. The overall composition is expansive but carefully organized, using the S-curve path and water to lead through repeated rounded forms toward the distant hills.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形童话风景画从高处俯看弯曲石路，路通向圆润山丘间的浅色小屋与鲜蓝湖泊。小路从下方中央进入，绕过浓密灌木向左弯，抵达几间奶油色石屋，屋顶陡斜、呈石板灰。深色门窗以简洁笔迹标出，旁边立着高而渐尖的树。小屋后方，饱和蓝色湖水横过中部，向远山之间收窄成水湾。水对岸更远处还有一栋浅色建筑，部分被深绿圆冠树木围住。前景密布小圆丘般灌木，色彩有橄榄绿、亮绿、青绿、蓝绿和暖褐。篱笆立柱沿道路右侧描出短短一线。两岸的田地分成弯曲黄绿色条带，顺着起伏山势而行。细密平行线和同心色带强调其圆润体积。树群在小球状树冠与高尖形之间交替，绿色中夹着少量橙与锈色。远方山谷爬入层叠丘陵，上方是清楚蓝天和一列巨大的奶油白云。视野中没有显著人物；右侧山坡上的少数浅色小点太小，无法确认为具体事物。表面处理密集，点状植被、田地的定向痕迹和小小深色轮廓让每个形状分明。明亮日光从左上方照来，暖化田地与建筑，湖水和树影则保留较冷的蓝绿纵深。整体构图开阔却经过精心组织，以S形小路和水域引领目光穿过重复的圆形，抵达远丘。
style_prompt_en: The storybook painting simplifies space into rounded, interlocking color masses with exceptionally dense small-scale texture. Lime, olive, mustard, teal, cobalt, rust, and pale cream recur across the frame in balanced clusters. Curved parallel marks and concentric bands give broad forms volume, while stippling and fine dark outlines distinguish adjacent smaller shapes. Repeated domes and narrow uprights alternate rhythmically; one or two winding bands lead the eye between near and far zones. Color changes and reduction in scale establish depth, but the surface remains decorative and carefully legible rather than photographic. Bright natural light warms exposed planes, leaving cool blue-green recesses that make the saturated highlights feel luminous. The many small marks never erase the large underlying color pattern. The overall effect is cheerful and immersive, with tactile detail organized by sweeping curves and a clear warm-cool structure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种童话绘画把空间简化为圆润、咬合的色彩大块，并填入格外密集的小尺度肌理。亮绿、橄榄绿、芥黄、青绿、钴蓝、锈色与浅奶油色以平衡的色群遍布画面。弯曲平行笔迹和同心色带赋予宽阔形体体积，点触与细深轮廓区分相邻的小形状。反复的圆丘和细窄竖形交替成节奏，一两道蜿蜒色带引导视线穿过近远区域。色彩转变和尺度缩小建立纵深，但表面仍富装饰性、清楚可读，而非摄影式。明亮自然光暖化外露体面，留下冷蓝绿凹处，使饱和亮部显得发光。众多小笔迹没有抹去下层宽大的颜色图案。整体效果欢快而有沉浸感，以扫过的曲线和清楚冷暖结构组织可触知的细节。
theme_en: A winding path, stone cottages, and a blue lake among rounded sunlit hills
theme_zh: 曲折小路与石屋通向被圆润阳光山丘环绕的蓝湖
name: Andy Russell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
